_provenance: Witness & collapse task tb-0099 (sub-13). Sky_Sun_Lighting (loop 3) is the Sun, realized as a configured DirectionalLight. The level template spawns a DirectionalLight but leaves it unlabeled/unconfigured (default white). Python/setup_sky_sun.py adopts that light, relabels it 'Sun', and configures it as a lunar-day sun (intensity 6.0, warm-white light_color 230,248,255), saved so PIE inherits it. The beat asserts actor_exists 'Sun' -- if the Sun light is missing/unlabeled the sky has no configured sun and the beat MUST FAIL rather than pass by silence. The lighting configuration (intensity + color) is additionally verified by a separate editor-world read-back, reported verbatim. Two independent live-PIE SimPlaytest sessions exercise it.
